title: LOADng RREQ rate limits (10/min per IID, 30/min global) not implemented
description: Spec 05-routing.md §10.3 (R-05-081): 'Implementations MUST rate-limit RREQ processing to at most 10 per minute per source IID and 30 per minute globally. RREQs exceeding these limits MUST be dropped before processing.' Evidence: no RREQ rate limiter in any of the three stacks (Rust rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs + lichen-node/src/hybrid.rs, C lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/loadng.c, Python python/src/lichen/loadng/). Duplicate/seen suppression exists (C loadng.c:414, Python _seen) but is not a rate limit. No test vector. Suggested placement: RREQ ingest path in each LOADng handler.
